meta.title: Welcome to Scaredy Cat
meta.description: How Scaredy Cat blurs horror before you see it, how to unblur a mistake, and how to block something it missed.

hero.title: Scaredy Cat read it so you don't have to.
hero.lede: Scaredy Cat blurs horror posters, thumbnails and trailers before they reach your screen. When you're curious, it tells you what happens instead.
hero.aside: Pin Scaredy Cat to your toolbar: click the puzzle piece next to the address bar, then the pin beside its name.

see.title: This is what a blocked picture looks like.
paragraphs: It works on IMDb, Netflix, YouTube, Letterboxd and most other sites. Detection runs on your computer, and the blur lands before the picture is drawn, so you never get a flash of the scary frame.
Click **Just tell me what happens** to read the plot without seeing a single frame, or **Show anyway** if you're feeling brave.
see.hint: Try the buttons. Nothing scary is under there.

demo.synopsis: A family moves into an old farmhouse where the attic door swings open every night at 3 a.m. The thing in the attic turns out to be a raccoon named Gary, who has lived there since 1987 and treats the family as his tenants. Nobody is hurt, and the dog and Gary end the film as close friends.
demo.revealToast: It was a raccoon the whole time.

mistake.title: If we blur something harmless, tell us.
steps: Point at the picture and click **This isn't horror**. That sends us a report, so Scaredy Cat stops making the same mistake.
To keep it visible on every visit, click the Scaredy Cat icon in your toolbar and press **Allow** next to it under Hidden items.

demo.reportToast: That's it. On a real page, this sends us the report.

missed.title: If something scary gets past Scaredy Cat, block it yourself.
paragraphs: Right-click the picture or video and choose **Report missed horror**. It's blurred right away and stays blurred on this computer from then on.
You can also click the Scaredy Cat icon in your toolbar, press **Report missed horror**, and then click the picture.
missed.tryButton: Try it: open the right-click menu

demo.reportToast: Blurred. On a real page, it stays blurred on this computer from now on.
demo.undoToast: On a real page, this undoes your report and lets us know.

loop.title: Every report makes Scaredy Cat a little smarter.
loop.body: Scaredy Cat learns from the mistakes you point out. One report about a wrong blur can fix that film for everyone.

cards.title: You flag a mistake
cards.text: A picture we blurred for no reason, or one we should have caught.

cards.title: We read every report
cards.text: A person looks at each one and corrects the title list or tunes detection for that kind of picture.

cards.title: Everyone gets the fix
cards.text: Scaredy Cat checks for a new title list every 6 hours, so corrections arrive without an update to install.

loop.consentDetail: Reports include the page and picture addresses, what we matched, your settings and any note you add. We never send the picture itself or your browsing history. You can turn this off anytime in the popup.
loop.consentOn: Sharing is on. Thanks for helping Scaredy Cat.
loop.consentOff: Sharing is off. Nothing will be sent.
loop.consentError: Couldn't save that. Try again in a moment.
loop.webConsent: To turn sharing on, click the Scaredy Cat icon in your toolbar and switch on **Share reports to improve detection**. It's off until you do.

note.title: Tell Scaredy Cat what you think.
note.body: Bugs, wrong blurs, sites you'd like covered: we read every note. Add your email if you'd like a reply.
note.emailPlaceholder: Email (optional, if you'd like a reply)
note.consentText: We'll send your note, your sensitivity setting and our version numbers, plus your email if you add one. It goes to our report database. We never send images or your browsing history. Sending also turns on report sharing, which you can turn off above or in the popup.

status.sent: Thanks! Scaredy Cat is taking notes 🙀
status.queued: Saved. We'll send it when you're back online 🙀
status.rateLimited: Easy there. Give it a moment.
status.failed: Couldn't send right now. Try again later.

note.webCard: Notes go through the extension. Click the Scaredy Cat icon in your toolbar and press **Send a note**.

band.title: You're all set. Go browse bravely.
band.body: Scaredy Cat is free and has no ads. If it saved you from a jump scare, you can buy the person who makes it a coffee.
band.cta: Buy Scaredy Cat's creator a coffee on Ko-fi

footer.aside: Keeping you safe from spooky stuff! 👻
